tasks.description: Implement a comprehensive vehicle filtering system for the Trailblaze Auto catalogue, including global search and multi-dimensional filters for brand, body style, fuel type, transmission, and price range.
acceptance_criteria: Search input with data-testid='search-input' must be visible on the vehicle catalogue page.
Searching for a car name or brand in the search input must result in matching results being displayed (using .car-card selector).
The Condition filter using data-testid='condition-filter-[Condition]' (All, New, Pre-Owned) must correctly narrow down vehicles.
The Brand dropdown filter with data-testid='brand-filter' must correctly show only vehicles of the selected brand.
The Body Style dropdown filter with data-testid='body-type-filter' must correctly show only vehicles of the selected body type.
Fuel Type and Transmission toggle pills with data-testid='fuel-filter-[Type]' and data-testid='transmission-filter-[Type]' must correctly filter inventory.
The Budget Range filter with data-testid='price-filter-[Range]' must correctly filter vehicles within the selected price brackets.
The 'Reset' or 'Clear All Filters' button with data-testid='reset-filters' must clear all active filters and restore the full available inventory.
A 'No matches found' message (using heading role) must be displayed when no vehicles satisfy the combined filtering criteria.
Searching with non-matching strings or special characters must show the 'No matches found' state (using data-testid='search-input').
The filtering system must correctly exclude vehicles marked as 'Sold', even if they match other criteria (Negative Case).
Selecting conflicting filter combinations must show an empty results state gracefully.
